# Command Reference

Action types (one router, used by voice + command bar + 3D console + control endpoint):

- workspace|launch|close|folder|web|memory|chat

Natural-language and direct commands both flow through `zoe_router.process()`. Native execution: Electron control endpoint `:7766` (`/action`, `/voice`, `/wake`). See COMMAND_SYSTEM_GUIDE.md for the full map.
